test_title: PYST 17: SSC JE CE - Reasoning (Held on: 23 Mar 2021 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the option in which the numbers share the same relationship as that shared by the given number - pair.

16 : 170
solution:
**__LOGIC__: [First Number × (First Number - 5)] - (First Number - 10) = Second Number**

The pattern followed here is :

Given number - pair :

16 : 170

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6534790beea829c5949d1cdd11cc63280e48760fee92f19510725d5424036a86.png] 

Similarly,

Option 1) 20 : 299 = 20 : (20 x 15 - 10 ≠ 299)

Option 2) 12 : 81 = 20 : (12 x 7 - 2 ≠ 81)

Option (3) 21 : 325

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/392b443fce1cb0b645e157f6160b867af2624f8bd3b8bc1e905fd66a58cb42f2.png] 

Option 4) 11 : 67 = (11 x 6 - 1 ≠ 67)

So, other three options are not followed this pattern.

Hence, the correct answer is** "21 : 325".**
